description.en_us: Keep the Rail Planner server mod in step with the LAN release site or GitHub releases. Polling can be switched off (check_interval_minutes=0); then a deploy request file triggers one pull: swap the jar, broadcast a countdown, restart, and write the result file.
description.zh_cn: 让服务端的 Rail Planner 模组跟着内网发布站或 GitHub release 更新。轮询可以关掉（check_interval_minutes=0），改成手动：丢一个部署请求文件，就拉一次、换 jar、广播倒计时、重启，结果写进结果文件。
